cashier.name: Cashier
cashier.description: Runs a checkout, and restocks or cleans when it is quiet. Speed sets how fast the line moves; friendliness lifts customer mood.

stocker.name: Stocker
stocker.description: Carries stock from the back room to the shelves.

cleaner.name: Cleaner
cleaner.description: Keeps the place clean. Dirty shops put customers in a bad mood.

cook.name: Cook
cook.description: Works cooking stations in food businesses.

mechanic.name: Mechanic
mechanic.description: Repairs broken machines and keeps them from failing.

security.name: Security Guard
security.description: Watches the door, chases shoplifters and throws out troublemakers. A fast guard catches more of them.

manager.name: Manager
manager.description: Reorders stock automatically and keeps the team's morale up.

driver.name: Delivery Driver
driver.description: Drives your van between warehouses, shops and vending machines.

lazy.name: Lazy
lazy.description: Slow, but asks for less pay.

loyal.name: Loyal
loyal.description: Stays cheerful and never quits over pay.

nightowl.name: Night Owl
nightowl.description: Does not tire on late shifts.

ambitious.name: Ambitious
ambitious.description: Learns quickly, but expects more pay.

tireless.name: Tireless
tireless.description: Barely loses energy during a shift.

flaky.name: Flaky
flaky.description: Calls in sick more than most.

veteran.name: Veteran
veteran.description: Experienced all-rounder with a wage to match.

sticky.name: Sticky Fingers
sticky.description: Something always goes missing on their shift.
